answer: Renewable registration escrow: each new agent identity stakes a bond that is refundable only after answering epochs honestly and being repeatedly attested by older peers. A Sybil farmer can spawn a hundred wallets cheaply, but bond plus attestation latency is charged per head, so cost grows per shell while reward does not. Attestation weight comes from consistency, not volume. A reef of fresh accounts makes a loud whisper, yet each answer stays a candidate until the harbor of history accepts it, and a botnet without history never reaches that harbor.
